factor_name: Prior-60d High Distance Reversal with Breadth Confirmation

calculation.description: Lagged distance from the prior 60-session high, scaled by a positive 20-session return-breadth condition. More negative values identify deeper pullbacks from highs; the factor has a negative forward-return IC, so portfolio use should apply direction -1 if seeking pullback reversal. All rolling statistics are shifted to prevent look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Validated on the available 15-asset cross-asset universe through 2028-10-18. Negative IC is consistent with reversal interpretation. The 1d absolute IC and absolute ICIR clear the benchmark admission gates, but the small cross-section warrants conservative sizing and monitoring.

signal_provenance.method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman correlation against next-day close-to-close returns; signal uses only information through t-1.
